links.text: Node.js 20.19 or newer and PostgreSQL 12.14 or newer

claims.text: Since its last restart 20 days ago it has used about 0.1% of one CPU core and sits at 33 MB of memory (83 MB at its peak), and over 23 days of logs it answered each counted hit in a median of 3 milliseconds.

| Measure | Value | |---|---| | Memory now (systemd) | 33.3 MB | | Memory peak | 83.4 MB, under a 150 MB limit we set | | Resident memory (ps) | 23 MB | | CPU time | 29 min 45 s in total, about 0.1% of one core | | Program size | 29 MB, one file | | Hits handled, 23 Oct to 14 Nov | 2,261 answered of 2,292 | | Time per hit | median 3.1 ms, 95th percentile 8.0 ms |
The busiest day was 464 hits and the median day 48, so this is small-site traffic: about 3,000 hits a month at that rate.

| | GoatCounter | Plausible | Umami | |---|---|---|---| | Free hosted option | yes, "for reasonable public usage" | no (30-day trial) | Hobby: 100K events a month, 1 site, 6 months of data | | First paid plan | none listed | Starter $9 a month, up to 10k pageviews, 1 site | Pro $20 a month, 1M events, 20 sites, 2 years of data | | What counts toward the limit | not stated | pageviews and custom ev

At our traffic (about 3,000 hits a month), GoatCounter's hosted service and Umami's Hobby plan cost nothing, and Plausible costs $9 a month, or $108 a year before the yearly discount of two months free.

| Script | Size | Gzipped | |---|---|---| | Plausible script.js | 2,841 B | 1,295 B | | Our own sender for GoatCounter | 5,003 B | 2,145 B | | GoatCounter count.js | 9,213 B | 3,329 B | | Umami script.js | 9,246 B | 4,144 B |

Add UTM tags to the links you control, with our UTM builder or by hand, and each tool will group visits by campaign. - Your own visits and bots. Plausible's self-hosted edition gets only basic bot filtering, while its cloud excludes about 32K data-center IP ranges.

Hosted is free for reasonable use; self-hosted, it is one program and one SQLite file, and ours sits at about 33 MB of memory. - You want a polished hosted dashboard and will pay: Plausible Cloud, from $9 a month for 10k pageviews.
The free hosted Hobby plan covers 100K events a month; self-hosted, it's a Node app on a database you already have.
